question:
Which of the following letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

LDH 14, NFJ 17, PHL 20, RJN 23, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fbb3b4c44c9fac42565e9a0a7f226792e7355dd3f8ad3b31149356883c0497d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b54f8175bddd46b4367e4cb99478248e2aec161ac9941256c4d29f93b5c84ae.png]
